assessment_artifact_read.description: Read the content behind an evidence record — inline payload for small structured evidence, or the stored file's text (truncated) for larger artifacts like file snapshots or test/build output. Binary content returns metadata only, not bytes.

evidenceId.description: Evidence record id whose content to read.

assessment_artifact_read.name: assessment_artifact_read

assessment_evidence_read.description: Read one evidence record by id (from assessment_evidence_search results).
assessment_evidence_read.name: assessment_evidence_read

assessment_evidence_search.description: Search the evidence timeline collected for a Work Session, optionally filtered by kind.

kind.description: Optional exact evidence kind filter. Use artifact_upload for uploaded artifacts.

assessment_evidence_search.name: assessment_evidence_search

assessment_framework_read.description: Read the evaluation framework (checklist/rubric criteria) assigned to a Work Session.
assessment_framework_read.name: assessment_framework_read

assessment_record.description: Record multiple criterion findings for a Work Session in one call. Send every finding this examiner owns as one batch. A repeated criterion from the same agent replaces its earlier finding.
assessment_record.name: assessment_record

assessment_report_create.description: Create the final evidence-backed readiness report for a Work Session from its assessment record findings. Requires human approval before it runs, and the created report is still only a draft — a human reviewer must separately confirm or override it before it is final. Never a substitute for that human confirmation.

summary.description: Evidence-backed readiness summary for the human reviewer.

assessment_report_create.name: assessment_report_create

assessment_review_ask.description: Ask the assessment subject one defense-interview question grounded in their actual work. Fire-and-forget: this does not wait for the answer itself — the Team pipeline pauses automatically between stages until the subject answers, then the next stage receives the exchange as context. Do not call a 'wait' tool; there isn't one.

questionText.description: The question to ask, in plain language.

assessment_review_ask.name: assessment_review_ask

assessment_review_request_demonstration.description: Ask the assessment subject to make a small live change and demonstrate understanding — more consequential than a text question, so this requires human approval before it runs. Fire-and-forget like assessment_review_ask; the Team pipeline pauses until they respond.

instructions.description: What to change and demonstrate, in plain language.

assessment_review_request_demonstration.name: assessment_review_request_demonstration

assessment_session_get.description: Read the Work Session under assessment: status, recipe, and metadata.
assessment_session_get.name: assessment_session_get

assessment_snapshot_compare.description: Diff two project snapshots by label; returns added/removed/changed file paths.
assessment_snapshot_compare.name: assessment_snapshot_compare

assessment_snapshot_read.description: Read a project snapshot (folder structure, file hashes) by label, or the latest if omitted.
assessment_snapshot_read.name: assessment_snapshot_read

brain_find_documents.description: Find company-brain documents by title/keyword (e.g. brochure). Returns documentId values to pass to whatsapp_send_document as brain_document_id when sending a real file to a contact.

query.description: Search text (e.g. brochure, UWA, PDF title words).

brain_find_documents.name: brain_find_documents

brain_query.description: Query the organization AI brain for policies and internal knowledge. Context is also injected automatically when enabled for the run.
brain_query.name: brain_query

browser.description: Control the browser. Pass action= to select the operation (navigate, snapshot, click, fill, type, extract/get, screenshot, wait, …). Prefer snapshot before click/fill. Use extract/get for page Q&A without a full dump.
browser.name: browser

browser_ab_click.description: Click element by selector or @ref from snapshot.
browser_ab_click.name: browser_ab_click

browser_ab_connect.description: Connect to browser via CDP port or URL.
browser_ab_connect.name: browser_ab_connect

browser_ab_cookies.description: Manage cookies: get, set, or clear.
browser_ab_cookies.name: browser_ab_cookies

browser_ab_drag.description: Drag from source selector to target selector.
browser_ab_drag.name: browser_ab_drag

browser_ab_find.description: Find element by locator (role, text, label, placeholder, alt, title, testid, first, last, nth) and act.
browser_ab_find.name: browser_ab_find

browser_ab_get.description: Get page info: text, html, value, attr, title, url, count, box, styles. A selector is required for text/html/value/attr/count/box/styles (omit it for whole-page html/text); title/url/cdp-url take no selector.
browser_ab_get.name: browser_ab_get

browser_ab_network.description: Network route, unroute, or list requests.
browser_ab_network.name: browser_ab_network

browser_ab_open.description: Navigate with agent-browser `open <url>`. Prefer snapshot after open to get @refs.
browser_ab_open.name: browser_ab_open

browser_ab_press.description: Press a key (Enter, Tab, Control+a, etc.).
browser_ab_press.name: browser_ab_press

browser_ab_screenshot.description: Screenshot; omit path to return image in JSON. Use full_page for full page.
browser_ab_screenshot.name: browser_ab_screenshot

browser_ab_set.description: Browser settings: viewport, device, geo, offline, headers, credentials, media.
browser_ab_set.name: browser_ab_set

browser_ab_snapshot.description: Accessibility tree with @refs (agent-browser snapshot). Use -i for interactive-only. Click/fill using @eN refs.
browser_ab_snapshot.name: browser_ab_snapshot

browser_ab_tab.description: Tab new, list, close, or switch by index.
browser_ab_tab.name: browser_ab_tab

browser_ab_type.description: Type into element (append). Use browser_ab_fill to clear first.
browser_ab_type.name: browser_ab_type

browser_ab_wait.description: Wait for selector, ms, text, url, load state, or JS (--fn).
browser_ab_wait.name: browser_ab_wait

browser_exec.description: Run any allowed agent-browser CLI command. Pass argv as the command tokens after `agent-browser --json`, e.g. ["find", "role", "button", "click", "--name", "Submit"]. See agent-browser --help for full list. Prefer browser_ab_* tools when available.
browser_exec.name: browser_exec

calendar_read.description: Read Google Calendar. action='list' lists upcoming events (optional timeMin/timeMax ISO-8601, query); action='get' fetches one event by eventId. Requires Calendar connected in Connectors → Google → Calendar.
calendar_read.name: calendar_read

calendar_write.description: Create, update, or delete Google Calendar events. action='create' needs summary, start, end (ISO-8601 or YYYY-MM-DD for all-day); optional attendees, description, location; set createMeetLink=true to attach a Meet URL (also requires meet.manage). action='update'/'delete' need eventId. Mutations may require JIT approval.
calendar_write.name: calendar_write

call_tool.description: Invoke a tool discovered via find_tools by exact name. Pass the catalog name only (for example crm_search), never find_tools, call_tool, or a functions.* prefix. Use when the tool is not in the default visible set.
call_tool.name: call_tool

create_report_pdf.description: Render a finished report to a PDF and return a shareable download link (plus a local path). Accepts a lightweight Markdown subset: # / ## / ### headings, **bold**, *italic*, and - bullet lists. Use this to package a competitor-research or research report as a document. Share the exact download link it returns with the user — never invent a link or a local file path (no sandbox: URLs). To also send it over WhatsApp, pass the returned local path to whatsapp_send.

content.description: The full report body as Markdown.

title.description: Report title — shown as the PDF heading and used for the file name.

create_report_pdf.name: create_report_pdf

create_xlsx.description: Create a real Excel .xlsx spreadsheet and return a shareable download link (plus a local path). Use whenever the user asks for a spreadsheet, Excel file, or .xlsx export. Provide 'rows' as a list of lists (first row = headers) or a list of objects (keys become the header row). Share the exact download link it returns with the user — never invent a link. To also send it over WhatsApp, pass the returned local path to whatsapp_send.

rows.description: Spreadsheet data: a list of rows where each row is a list of cell values, OR a list of objects (keys become the header row).

title.description: Used for the file name when generating the spreadsheet.

create_xlsx.name: create_xlsx

crm_add_note.description: Add a note/comment on a CRM record.

recordId.description: Zoho record id (long numeric string from crm_search), or name/ordinal — resolved automatically.

crm_add_note.name: crm_add_note

crm_bulk_create.description: Create multiple CRM records in one call (platform batch limits apply).
crm_bulk_create.name: crm_bulk_create

crm_bulk_update.description: Update multiple CRM records. Each record needs id in fields or parallel recordIds array.
crm_bulk_update.name: crm_bulk_update

crm_convert_lead.description: Convert a lead to contact/account/deal (platform-specific; supported on Zoho, Salesforce, etc.).
crm_convert_lead.name: crm_convert_lead

crm_create.description: Create a CRM record (Leads, Contacts, Deals, etc.). Use crm_describe_module for field API names. When the user asks to add or create a record, call this tool immediately with the fields they gave — do not tell them to check the dashboard first. If approval is required, an Approve/Deny card appears in this chat; after they approve once, later CRM writes in this conversation proceed automatically.
crm_create.name: crm_create

crm_delete.description: Delete a CRM record. Call this tool when the user asks to delete — an Approve/Deny prompt appears in this chat if approval is required; do not ask the user to check the dashboard.

recordId.description: Zoho record id (long numeric string from crm_search), or name/ordinal — resolved automatically.

crm_delete.name: crm_delete

crm_describe_module.description: Get field API names, types, and picklists for a CRM module. Use before create/update.
crm_describe_module.name: crm_describe_module

crm_download_attachment.description: Download a CRM attachment as base64.

recordId.description: Zoho record id (long numeric string from crm_search), or name/ordinal — resolved automatically.

crm_download_attachment.name: crm_download_attachment

crm_get.description: Fetch a single CRM record by module and record id.

recordId.description: Zoho record id (long numeric string from crm_search), or name/ordinal — resolved automatically.

crm_get.name: crm_get

crm_link.description: Link two related CRM records (e.g. deal to account).

recordId.description: Zoho record id (long numeric string from crm_search), or name/ordinal — resolved automatically.

crm_link.name: crm_link

crm_list_attachments.description: List file attachments on a CRM record.

recordId.description: Zoho record id (long numeric string from crm_search), or name/ordinal — resolved automatically.

crm_list_attachments.name: crm_list_attachments

crm_list_modules.description: List available CRM modules/objects for the connected platform (Leads, Contacts, Deals, custom modules, etc.). Call this first when unsure of module names.
crm_list_modules.name: crm_list_modules

crm_query.description: Run an advanced read-only query against the connected CRM (COQL on Zoho, provider-native query language returned by crm_list_modules). Use for filters, date ranges, and aggregations. On Zoho: every SELECT needs WHERE (e.g. WHERE id is not null); use COUNT(id) not COUNT(*) or count(id); write null checks as lowercase is not null / is null (not IS NOT NULL); use != not <>.
crm_query.name: crm_query

crm_search.description: Simple search or list records in a CRM module. Optional word filter.
crm_search.name: crm_search

crm_unlink.description: Remove a link between two CRM records.

recordId.description: Zoho record id (long numeric string from crm_search), or name/ordinal — resolved automatically.

crm_unlink.name: crm_unlink

crm_update.description: Update an existing CRM record. Provide only changed fields.

recordId.description: Zoho record id (long numeric string from crm_search), or name/ordinal — resolved automatically.

crm_update.name: crm_update

crm_upload_attachment.description: Upload a file attachment to a CRM record. Provide fileBase64 from a generated/sandbox file.

recordId.description: Zoho record id (long numeric string from crm_search), or name/ordinal — resolved automatically.

crm_upload_attachment.name: crm_upload_attachment

delegate_task.description: DEPRECATED: prefer spawn_subagents. Fire-and-forget child AgentRun on the same agent (cannot safely await — runner deadlock). Returns the child run id.

skills.description: Optional skill/scope filter for the child

delegate_task.name: delegate_task

docs_read.description: Read a Google Doc. action='get' returns title and plain text for documentId. Requires Docs connected in Connectors → Google → Docs.
docs_read.name: docs_read

docs_write.description: Create or update Google Docs. action='create' needs title (+ optional text); action='append' needs documentId + text; action='replace_all' needs documentId + findText (+ replaceText). Mutations may require JIT approval.
docs_write.name: docs_write

done.description: Signal that the task is complete when no further tools are needed.
done.name: done

drive_read.description: Read Google Drive or OneDrive. action='list' searches/lists files (optional query string; optional parentId to list a folder); action='get' returns metadata for fileId; action='get_content' downloads file text content. When drive_provider_selection_required is returned, ask the user which listed drive to use and retry this operation with provider='google' or provider='microsoft'. Do not assume a provider and do not carry a prior choice to another operation.

parentId.description: OneDrive/Google folder id to list children of (action=list).

provider.description: Drive provider selected by the user when both Google Drive and OneDrive are connected. google = Google Drive, microsoft = OneDrive.

drive_read.name: drive_read

drive_write.description: Create, update, or delete files in Google Drive or OneDrive. action='create' needs name (+ optional contentText/mimeType/parentId); action='update' needs fileId (+ optional name/contentText); action='delete' needs fileId. Mutations may pause for one-time Approve/Deny in chat (JIT). When drive_provider_selection_required is returned, ask the user which listed drive to use and retry this operation with provider='google' or provider='microsoft'. Do not assume a provider and do not carry a prior choice to another operation.

provider.description: Drive provider selected by the user when both Google Drive and OneDrive are connected. google = Google Drive, microsoft = OneDrive.

drive_write.name: drive_write

email_read.description: Read or search emails from a connected Gmail or Microsoft 365 account. Use query for mailbox search text (Gmail operators work only with Gmail). Provide messageId to fetch a single message. File attachments are downloaded into the Qlix sandbox (same store as agent-generated files), and extractable text (PDF/DOCX/XLSX/CSV/text) is included in each message's attachments[].extractedText for you to use. Also share attachments[].url download links with the user when relevant. Images may only have a URL (no text extract).

includeAttachments.description: Download + extract attachments into the sandbox and return their text to you (default true). Set false only for a quick metadata scan without files.

maxResults.description: Maximum messages to return (1-25). Defaults to 10.

messageId.description: Optional mailbox message id to fetch a single message.

provider.description: Mailbox to use. Omit when one mailbox is connected. If the tool returns email_provider_selection_required, ask the user which listed mailbox to use, then retry with their selected provider.

query.description: Mailbox search query. Defaults to unread mail.

email_read.name: email_read

email_send.description: Send / draft / list drafts / delete draft via Gmail or Microsoft 365. ROUTE FROM THE USER MESSAGE using mode: mode='draft' to compose/prepare/write without sending; mode='send' to deliver; mode='list_drafts' to list existing mailbox drafts (use this before deleting when you don't already have a draftId); mode='delete_draft' to delete a draft (requires draftId from a prior draft create or list_drafts — never invent draftId). Default to mode='send' only when intent is clearly to deliver. IMPORTANT: mode=draft does NOT deliver mail. Tell the user the draft is in the connected mailbox's Drafts (see mailboxEmail in the tool result), and never say 'sent' for a draft. Recipients in 'to' only prefill the draft. CRITICAL for mode=send: only send to REAL email addresses provided by the user or obtained from trusted tools. NEVER invent or guess addresses (e.g. info@cafe1.com, contact@business2.com) — fabricated recipients are rejected by the server. Never use placeholder addresses like info@mysite.com. The first mode=send in a chat may pause for one-time Approve/Deny in this chat; draft / list_drafts / delete_draft never require approval. When email_provider_selection_required is returned, ask the user which listed mailbox to use and retry this operation with provider='google' or provider='microsoft'. Do not assume a provider and do not carry a prior choice to another operation.

draftId.description: Mailbox draft resource id for mode=delete_draft. Get it from mode=draft response or mode=list_drafts.

maxResults.description: For mode=list_drafts: max drafts to return (1-25).

mode.description: send = deliver now (JIT may apply). draft = save to Gmail Drafts. list_drafts = list drafts (returns draftId values). delete_draft = permanently delete a draft by draftId.

provider.description: Mailbox provider selected by the user when multiple mailboxes are connected.

replyToMessageId.description: Optional mailbox message id to reply in-thread.

to.description: Recipient email addresses. Required for mode=send; optional for mode=draft; unused for list/delete.

email_send.name: email_send

find_tools.description: Search the expanded tool catalog (MCP + browser_ab_* + connectors) when the default tool list is too large. Returns matching tool names and short docs.

query.description: Keyword or substring to search tool names/descriptions

find_tools.name: find_tools

forms_read.description: Read Google Forms. action='get' returns form metadata/items including responderUri (the shareable respondent link — paste it for the user) and formId; action='list_responses' lists submitted responses. Use get when the user asks for an existing form's link and formId is known. Requires Forms connected in Connectors → Google → Forms.
forms_read.name: forms_read

forms_write.description: Create or update Google Forms. action='create' needs title and returns formId plus responderUri — always give the user responderUri as the shareable link. action='update_info' needs formId (+ title/description); action='add_question' needs formId + questionTitle. Do not create a new form just to recover a link; use forms_read get or recent conversation. Mutations may require JIT approval.
forms_write.name: forms_write

gui_control.description: Control desktop apps via Agent-S3 (screenshot + UI actions). Use for native apps; prefer luna_local_read_file / luna_local_bash for files.
gui_control.name: gui_control

luna_local_bash.description: Run a shell command in the session cwd (PowerShell on Windows, bash on Mac/Linux). Safe inspect commands (ls, git status, …) run without approval; destructive or unknown commands require JIT. Prefer luna_local_search_files / luna_local_patch for file work; use luna_local_cd to change cwd (cd in a subshell does not persist).
luna_local_bash.name: luna_local_bash

luna_local_cd.description: Change the hybrid session working directory. Relative paths for file tools and luna_local_bash use this cwd afterward. Prefer this over `cd` inside luna_local_bash (subshell).

path.description: Directory to make the new session cwd

luna_local_cd.name: luna_local_cd

luna_local_code_task.description: Run a multi-step coding subtask via Agent-S3 CodeAgent (bash/python). Use for spreadsheet/doc automation; requires local LLM API keys.
luna_local_code_task.name: luna_local_code_task

luna_local_create_pdf.description: Create a real PDF file on the user's computer from text or markdown. Use this whenever the user asks to 'create/make/generate a PDF' or document — do NOT tell the user to copy-paste into Word. Supports markdown headings (#, ##, ###) and bullet lines ('- ' or '* '). Returns the absolute path of the created PDF, which you can then pass to luna_local_send_whatsapp_document.

content.description: Body text or markdown for the PDF.

output_path.description: Optional absolute path for the .pdf. If omitted, it is saved to the user's Documents folder using a slug of the title.

luna_local_create_pdf.name: luna_local_create_pdf

luna_local_create_xlsx.description: Create a real Excel .xlsx spreadsheet on the user's computer. Use this whenever the user asks for a spreadsheet/Excel/xlsx file — do NOT use luna_local_write_file for .xlsx (that produces a corrupt file Excel cannot open). Provide 'rows' as a list of lists (first row = headers) or a list of objects. Returns the absolute path, which you can pass to luna_local_send_whatsapp_document.

output_path.description: Optional absolute path for the .xlsx. If omitted, saved to the user's Documents folder using a slug of the title.

rows.description: Spreadsheet data: a list of rows where each row is a list of cell values, OR a list of objects (keys become the header row).

title.description: Used for the filename when output_path is omitted.

luna_local_create_xlsx.name: luna_local_create_xlsx

luna_local_list_dir.description: List files and folders in a directory on the user's computer.
luna_local_list_dir.name: luna_local_list_dir

luna_local_open_file.description: Open a file or folder on the user's computer with the default app or File Explorer (like remote desktop — windows appear on their screen, not in Qlix). Use mode 'folder' to open a directory in Explorer/Finder; 'reveal' to highlight a file in its folder.

application.description: Optional app name or path (e.g. notepad, code, excel). Windows only.

mode.description: default=launch with associated app; folder=open directory; reveal=show in file manager.

path.description: Absolute path to file or folder.

luna_local_open_file.name: luna_local_open_file

luna_local_patch.description: Edit files on the host. mode=replace (default): exact old_string→new_string in one file. mode=patch: Hermes V4A multi-file patch (*** Begin Patch … *** End Patch) with Add/Update/Delete/Move; validated atomically then applied. Prefer replace for single surgical edits; use patch for scaffolding or multi-file structural changes. On failure, re-read and use fuzzy 'Did you mean' hints; after repeated failures use luna_local_write_file.

mode.description: replace=single-file exact swap (default); patch=V4A multi-file body

patch.description:
V4A patch body (mode=patch). Example:
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: src/main.py
+print('hi')
*** Update File: README.md
@@
-# Old
+# New
*** End Patch

path.description: File to patch (replace mode; absolute or cwd-relative)

replace_all.description: Replace every occurrence (replace mode; default false)

luna_local_patch.name: luna_local_patch

luna_local_pwd.description: Return the hybrid session working directory used for relative paths and luna_local_bash.
luna_local_pwd.name: luna_local_pwd

luna_local_python.description: Run a short Python snippet locally via Agent-S3 LocalEnv.
luna_local_python.name: luna_local_python

luna_local_read_file.description: Read a text file on the user's computer. Provide the full absolute path (e.g. C:\Users\...\file.log on Windows). Use max_lines for large logs; prefer this over luna_local_python for read-only log review.
luna_local_read_file.name: luna_local_read_file

luna_local_search_files.description: Search file contents or find files by name (Hermes search_files). Prefer this over grep/find in luna_local_bash. target=content for regex in files; target=files for glob by name.

context.description: Context lines around each match (content mode)

output_mode.description: For content search: matching lines, paths only, or counts

path.description: Directory or file to search (default: session cwd)

pattern.description: Regex for content search, or glob (e.g. '*.py') for file search

target.description: content=grep inside files; files=find by name

luna_local_search_files.name: luna_local_search_files

luna_local_send_whatsapp_document.description: Send a local file (e.g. a PDF created with luna_local_create_pdf) to the user's linked WhatsApp. Provide the absolute file_path. Use after creating a document when the user asked to send it on WhatsApp.

file_name.description: Optional display name for the document in WhatsApp.

file_path.description: Absolute path to the file to send.

luna_local_send_whatsapp_document.name: luna_local_send_whatsapp_document

luna_local_write_file.description: Write text to a file on the user's computer (overwrite).
luna_local_write_file.name: luna_local_write_file

meet_manage.description: Manage Google Meet spaces. action='create' makes a new meeting and returns meetingUri; action='get' loads a space by name (spaces/xxx); action='end' ends the active conference for that space. create/end may require JIT approval. Prefer calendar_write createMeetLink=true when scheduling a calendar event with a Meet link.

name.description: Space resource name for get/end, e.g. spaces/abc-defg-hij.

meet_manage.name: meet_manage

notion_read.description: Read from the connected Notion workspace. action='search' finds pages/databases (optional query, filter='page'|'database'); action='get_page' returns page metadata + markdown content for pageId; action='query_database' lists rows in databaseId (optional filterJson/sorts). Requires Connectors → Notion.
notion_read.name: notion_read

notion_write.description: Create or update Notion content. action='create_page' needs title + parentPageId or parentDatabaseId (+ optional contentMarkdown/properties); action='update_page' needs pageId + contentMarkdown and/or title (appends markdown blocks); action='create_database_row' needs databaseId (+ title/properties/contentMarkdown). Pass page body as markdown — it is converted to Notion blocks. Mutations may pause for Approve/Deny in chat (JIT).

contentMarkdown.description: Markdown / plain text converted to Notion blocks.

properties.description: Database/page properties. Flat string/number/boolean values are coerced; Notion-shaped property objects are passed through.

notion_write.name: notion_write

research_github.description: Search GitHub repos or read a repo (owner/name) via gh CLI.

mode.description: search = find repos; repo = view one repo. Default search.

query.description: Search query OR owner/repo for repo view.

research_github.name: research_github

research_read_url.description: Read a URL as clean text. Uses Jina Reader for generic pages; auto-routes Twitter/GitHub/YouTube/Bilibili URLs to platform CLIs when available.
research_read_url.name: research_read_url

research_social_search.description: Search a social platform (Twitter/X, Reddit, Xiaohongshu). Requires platform login/cookies configured on the runner for some platforms.
research_social_search.name: research_social_search

research_video.description: Extract video metadata and subtitles from YouTube or Bilibili URLs via yt-dlp / bili-cli (Agent Reach).
research_video.name: research_video

research_web_search.description: Semantic web search via Exa (Agent Reach). Use for broad research, comparisons, and finding articles — not for login or form submission.
research_web_search.name: research_web_search

sheets_read.description: Read Google Sheets. action='get' returns spreadsheet metadata; action='get_values' needs range (e.g. Sheet1!A1:C10). Requires Sheets connected in Connectors → Google → Sheets.
sheets_read.name: sheets_read

sheets_write.description: Create or update Google Sheets. action='create' needs title; action='update_values'/'append_values' need spreadsheetId, range, and values (2D array of cells). Mutations may require JIT approval.
sheets_write.name: sheets_write

slack_create_channel.description: Create a public or private Slack channel on behalf of the connected user.
slack_create_channel.name: slack_create_channel

slack_create_list_item.description: Add a task row to a channel project tracker / Slack List — not a chat message. Always pass channel (#todo). Never guess listId; omit listId unless returned by slack_find_channel_lists.

channel.description: Channel name (#todo) or id — required for project tracker tasks.

listId.description: Only use when copied from slack_find_channel_lists.

listTitle.description: Optional list/tab title when a channel has multiple lists.

status.description: Optional Status label, e.g. In progress.

slack_create_list_item.name: slack_create_list_item

slack_delete_list_item.description: Permanently delete a project-tracker task only after the user explicitly asked to delete it. Pass channel plus taskTitle; never delete a chat message.

listId.description: Only if copied from Slack tool output.

slack_delete_list_item.name: slack_delete_list_item

slack_describe_list.description: Describe a Slack List (project tracker). Prefer channel (#todo) — Qlix resolves the List id (F…). Do not pass channel ids (C…) or guessed F ids as listId.

listId.description: Slack List id (F…) only if already known.

slack_describe_list.name: slack_describe_list

slack_find_channel_lists.description: Find Slack Lists attached to a channel (project tracker / List tab). Returns list ids (F…) — use these with slack_create_list_item, not the channel id (C…). Do not use slack_post_message for tracker tasks.

listTitle.description: Optional list/tab title to pick (e.g. Project tracker).

slack_find_channel_lists.name: slack_find_channel_lists

slack_get_history.description: Read recent messages from a Slack channel or DM by channel id.

channel.description: Channel id (C… or G… or D…).

slack_get_history.name: slack_get_history

slack_list_channels.description: List Slack channels the connected user can access. Use before posting when you need a channel id (starts with C or G).
slack_list_channels.name: slack_list_channels

slack_list_list_items.description: List or search tasks in a channel project tracker / Slack List, never channel messages.

listId.description: Slack List id (F…) if already known.

slack_list_list_items.name: slack_list_list_items

slack_list_users.description: List workspace members (use slack_open_dm with a user id to start a DM).

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a prior call.

slack_list_users.name: slack_list_users

slack_open_dm.description: Open a direct message with a workspace member; returns channel id for slack_post_message.
slack_open_dm.name: slack_open_dm

slack_post_message.description: Post a chat message to a Slack channel or DM as the connected Slack user. Use only when the user explicitly asks to send, post, or reply to chat; use slack_create_list_item for project-tracker tasks. Requires slack.send scope and user approval when JIT is enabled.

channel.description: Channel name (#todo) or id to post in.

threadTs.description: Optional thread timestamp to reply in a thread.

slack_post_message.name: slack_post_message

slack_search_messages.description: Search Slack messages across the workspace.
slack_search_messages.name: slack_search_messages

slack_set_channel_topic.description: Set the topic/description of a Slack channel.
slack_set_channel_topic.name: slack_set_channel_topic

slack_set_list_task_completion.description: Complete or reopen a project-tracker task. Pass channel and taskTitle.

completed.description: True to complete; false to reopen.

listId.description: Only if copied from Slack tool output.

slack_set_list_task_completion.name: slack_set_list_task_completion

slack_set_presence.description: Set the connected user's Slack presence to active (auto) or away.
slack_set_presence.name: slack_set_presence

slack_update_list_item.description: Update a project tracker task row. Pass channel (#todo) and taskTitle (task name). Use status for Status column (e.g. In progress, Done). Do not guess listId or use taskTitle as itemId — item ids start with Rec.

itemId.description: Row id (Rec…) if returned from create.

status.description: Status label: Not started, In progress, Blocked, Done.

taskTitle.description: Existing task name to find the row (e.g. yeshwanth).

slack_update_list_item.name: slack_update_list_item

slides_read.description: Read a Google Slides presentation. action='get' returns title and per-slide text. Requires Slides connected in Connectors → Google → Slides.
slides_read.name: slides_read

slides_write.description: Create or update Google Slides. action='create' needs title; action='replace_all' needs presentationId + findText; action='insert_text' needs presentationId + text. Mutations may require JIT approval.
slides_write.name: slides_write

think.description: Record a reasoning step without executing an external action.
think.name: think

whatsapp_auto_reply_set_instructions.description: Set or update what this agent should do when a contact replies (auto-reply session). Call after messaging them, or with a resolvable name/phone/jid. Requires whatsapp.auto_reply.

instructions.description: What to do when they reply, e.g. 'Book a 30-min call and confirm the time.'

recipient.description: Contact name, phone with country code, or jid.

whatsapp_auto_reply_set_instructions.name: whatsapp_auto_reply_set_instructions

whatsapp_auto_reply_status.description: List contacts this agent is currently listening to for auto-reply (armed after whatsapp_send_message when whatsapp.auto_reply is granted).
whatsapp_auto_reply_status.name: whatsapp_auto_reply_status

whatsapp_auto_reply_stop.description: Stop listening for auto-replies. Pass recipient (name/phone/jid) to stop one contact, or omit to stop all active listeners for this agent.

recipient.description: Optional contact name, phone, or jid to stop.

whatsapp_auto_reply_stop.name: whatsapp_auto_reply_stop

whatsapp_list_contacts.description: Search the user's WhatsApp phonebook/contacts by name or phone. Use only when the user asks about contacts or who to message. Requires whatsapp.read or whatsapp.contact_send.

query.description: Optional name or phone fragment to filter contacts.

whatsapp_list_contacts.name: whatsapp_list_contacts

whatsapp_read_chat.description: Read recent 1:1 WhatsApp messages with a contact. Pass a contact name, phone (with country code), or WhatsApp jid. Only use when the user explicitly asks to read/summarize a chat. Requires whatsapp.read. Messages are buffered while WhatsApp stays linked — older history may be empty until the chat is active.

recipient.description: Contact name, phone with country code, or jid.

whatsapp_read_chat.name: whatsapp_read_chat

whatsapp_send.description: Send a file (PDF, image, screenshot, document) produced during this run to the user's linked WhatsApp self-chat (Message yourself). Not for messaging other contacts — use whatsapp_send_document (file) or whatsapp_send_message (text). Requires the whatsapp.send scope.

file_name.description: Optional display name shown in WhatsApp. Always include the real extension (e.g. .xlsx, .pdf); defaults to the file's name.

file_path.description: Absolute path to the file in the runner.

whatsapp_send.name: whatsapp_send

whatsapp_send_document.description: Send a real file (PDF brochure, spreadsheet, etc.) to a WhatsApp contact. REQUIRED when the user asks to send a brochure/document — never paste a link or placeholder like [Brochure Link] in a text message. Prefer brain_document_id from brain citations / brain_find_documents (company brain). Alternatively pass file_path for a runner-local file. Requires whatsapp.contact_send (+ brain.query when using brain_document_id). On team wait runs the file is queued and sent in order with other messages.

brain_document_id.description: Brain document id (from brain context documentId=… or brain_find_documents). Preferred for brochures stored in the company brain.

file_name.description: Optional display name (keep a real extension, e.g. .pdf).

recipient.description: Contact name, phone with country code, or jid.

reply_instructions.description: Optional. What this agent should do when that contact replies (requires whatsapp.auto_reply).

whatsapp_send_document.name: whatsapp_send_document

whatsapp_send_message.description: Send a WhatsApp text message to a contact from the user's phonebook, or to a phone number with country code. ONLY call this when the user explicitly asked to message that person (never unsolicited outreach). Requires whatsapp.contact_send and dashboard/WhatsApp approval the first time in a chat. You may send several messages to the same contact in order — follow with whatsapp_send_document and/or whatsapp_send_poll when the user asked for a file or poll. If this agent also has whatsapp.auto_reply, sending arms a 24h listener so contact replies auto-route back to this agent. On team wait runs, messages are queued until the wait duration is set and then delivered in queue order.

recipient.description: Contact name, phone with country code, or jid.

reply_instructions.description: Optional. What this agent should do when that contact replies (requires whatsapp.auto_reply). Stored on the listen session.

whatsapp_send_message.name: whatsapp_send_message

whatsapp_send_poll.description: Send a native WhatsApp poll to a contact (name, phone with country code, or jid). REQUIRED when the user asks for an interest poll — do NOT replace this with a text message that says 'reply Interested/Not Interested'. Votes are captured as the contact's reply (selected option text). Requires whatsapp.contact_send and the same JIT approval as whatsapp_send_message. On team wait runs the poll is queued until the wait duration is set and sent in order.

name.description: Poll question shown in WhatsApp (max 255 chars).

recipient.description: Contact name, phone with country code, or jid.

reply_instructions.description: Optional. What this agent should do when that contact votes or replies (requires whatsapp.auto_reply).

selectableCount.description: How many options the contact can pick (default 1).

whatsapp_send_poll.name: whatsapp_send_poll

semantics: maximum supported managed-runtime surface; runtime selection, scopes, JIT policy, tool profile, configuration, credentials, and dependencies still gate availability
